title: Blank Cells Indicating Answers to Be Inserted

illustrates.quote: Use guide dots across the width of a column to indicate a blank space or a blank to be filled in. Explain the series of guide dots in a transcriber's note. Sample: A series of guide dots across the width of a column indicates a blank space. (See ... Sample 11-10: Blank Cells Indicating Answers to Be Inserted on page 11-35 ...)

print.notes: The right-hand column is entirely blank in print — a worksheet for the student/reader to fill in temperature readings.
print.printFeatures: Bordered box, ruled lines between rows; header row bold.

braille.notes: Line 1 placeholder "text". A transcriber's note before the table (lines 4-5) explains: "Guide dots indicate a space for an answer." Each day's row then shows a full run of dot-5 guide-dot filler characters across the width of the (otherwise blank) second column, shaded grey in the PDF sample image, matching the print blanks.

resolution: No content differences beyond header-schema normalization; both runs match the source exactly.
